questions.prompt: Which of these sports are played over a net?
questions.fact: Squash is played off a front wall, and handball and water polo are both played into a goal. None of the three has a net between the sides.

questions.prompt: Which of these were written by Charles Dickens?
questions.fact: Dickens published most of his novels a chapter at a time in magazines, so he could change the plot if readers hated it.

questions.prompt: How many years did the Second World War last?
questions.fact: Six, from the invasion of Poland in September 1939 to the surrender of Japan in September 1945.

questions.prompt: How many calories are in one large hen's egg?
questions.fact: About 72, and almost all of the fat sits in the yolk. The white is mostly water and protein.

questions.prompt: Which band recorded the album The Dark Side of the Moon?
questions.hint: The cover is a prism splitting white light into a rainbow.
questions.fact: It stayed on the US album chart for more than fourteen years, which no record has matched.

questions.prompt: In Greek myth, which god ruled the sea?
questions.hint: His brothers took the sky and the underworld.
questions.fact: The three brothers drew lots for the world. Zeus got the sky, Hades the underworld, Poseidon the sea.
